## 📋 Pull Request Summary

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes proposed in this pull request.

---

## 🎯 Type of Change

Please mark the relevant option(s) with an `x`:

- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ **New Feature** (non-breaking change which adds gameplay or UI capability)
- [ ] 🎨 **UI / Visual Enhancement** (changes to themes, animations, or styling)
- [ ] 🔊 **Audio / Effects** (sound synthesis or particle engine improvements)
- [ ] 🧠 **AI Optimization** (heuristics, minimax, or bot behavior improvements)
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance Optimization** (rendering, memory, or CPU efficiency)
- [ ] 📝 **Documentation Update** (README, Contributing guide, or code comments)
- [ ] 📦 **Build & Packaging** (installer, single-file publish, or GitHub Actions CI)

---

## 🔗 Related Issues

Closes # (issue number)

## 🧪 Testing & Verification

Describe how you tested these changes:
- [ ] Solution builds cleanly with zero errors/warnings (`dotnet build Tic-Tac-Fusion.sln`)
- [ ] Game runs and was tested locally on Windows (`dotnet run --project TicTacFusion`)
- [ ] Tested across different grid dimensions (3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6)
- [ ] Tested across all 3 visual themes (Cyber Neon, Obsidian Emerald, Synthwave Sunset)
- [ ] Tested Timed Mode / Speed Blitz countdown mechanics (if gameplay modified)
